items.source:
Create a PropertySource having the given name based on Properties
loaded from the given encoded resource.
items.translation: 基于从给定编码资源加载的属性，创建具有指定名称的 PropertySource。

items.source: Return a potentially adapted variant of this ResourcePropertySource, overriding the previously given (or derived) name with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回一个可能经过调整的此ResourcePropertySource的变体，用指定的名称覆盖之前给定（或推导）的名称。

items.source: Return a potentially adapted variant of this ResourcePropertySource, overriding the previously given name (if any) with the original resource name (equivalent to the name generated by the name-less constructor variants).
items.translation: 返回一个经过潜在调整的此ResourcePropertySource的变体，用原始资源名称（等同于无参构造函数变体生成的名称）覆盖之前给定的名称（如果有）。

items.source: Create a PropertySource based on Properties loaded from the given resource. The name of the PropertySource will be generated based on the description of the given resource.
items.translation: 基于从给定资源加载的属性创建 PropertySource。PropertySource 的名称将根据给定资源的 description 生成。

items.source: Both traditional and XML-based properties file formats are supported; however, in order for XML processing to take effect, the underlying Resource's getFilename() method must return a non-null value that ends in ".xml".
items.translation: 同时支持传统的和基于 XML 的属性文件格式；但是，为了使 XML 处理生效，底层 `Resource` 的getFilename()方法必须返回一个非`null`且以`".xml"`结尾的值。

items.source: Create a PropertySource based on Properties loaded from the given resource location and use the given class loader to load the resource, assuming it is prefixed with classpath:. The name of the PropertySource will be generated based on the description of the resource.
items.translation: 基于从给定资源位置加载的属性创建 PropertySource，并使用给定的类加载器加载该资源，假设其以classpath:为前缀。PropertySource 的名称将根据资源的description生成。

items.source: Create a PropertySource based on Properties loaded from the given resource location. The name of the PropertySource will be generated based on the description of the resource.
items.translation: 基于从给定资源位置加载的属性创建 PropertySource。PropertySource 的名称将根据资源的 description 生成。

items.source: Create a PropertySource having the given name based on Properties loaded from the given resource location and using the given class loader to load the resource (assuming it is prefixed with classpath:).
items.translation: 根据给定名称创建一个 PropertySource，该 PropertySource 基于从给定资源位置加载的 Properties，并使用给定的类加载器加载该资源（假设其以classpath:开头）。

items.source: Create a PropertySource having the given name based on Properties loaded from the given resource location. The default thread context class loader will be used to load the resource (assuming the location string is prefixed with classpath:).
items.translation: 根据给定的资源位置加载属性，并基于该名称创建 PropertySource。默认线程上下文类加载器将用于加载资源（假设位置字符串以 classpath: 开头）。

items.source: Create a PropertySource based on Properties loaded from the given resource.
items.translation: 基于给定资源中加载的属性创建 PropertySource。

items.source: Create a PropertySource based on Properties loaded from the given resource location and use the given class loader to load the resource, assuming it is prefixed with classpath:.
items.translation: 基于从给定资源位置加载的 Properties 创建 PropertySource，并使用给定的类加载器加载该资源，假设其以classpath:为前缀。

items.source:
Create a PropertySource based on Properties loaded from the given resource
location.
items.translation: 基于从给定资源位置加载的属性创建 PropertySource。

items.source:
Create a PropertySource having the given name based on Properties loaded from
the given resource location.
items.translation: 根据给定名称创建基于从给定资源位置加载的 Properties 的 PropertySource。
